correctness.rationale: For every n>=5 and (a,b) in {0,...,4}^2, the necessary-and-sufficient local indicator equation converts all solutions into periodic cycles of a deterministic four-bit transition graph. Each state has at most one predecessor and one successor. All 25 graphs have only 16 states; exact complete enumeration gives precisely the printed eleven nonconstant cycles. Primitive-cycle divisibility and rotation give the counts. The executable verify.py recomputes the cycle census and independently exhaustive adjacency tests for n=5..14. This is a finite exhaustive lemma supporting an unrestricted proof, not a generalization inferred from tests.

value.rationale: Complete structural classification for all 25 regular-set parameters of a standard infinite graph family, sharper than the motivating existence criteria. The classification proves universal bounded period, supplies all exact labelled counts, distinguishes nonconjugate (1,2) orbits and isolates a genuine extra (2,2) phase when 6 divides n. The structural and exact-enumerative distinctions are mathematical outputs, not just a verification script or routine restatement.
